title: Transfer Of Value Protocol
tagline: The protocol that governs the rules of tomorrow.
description: The protocol solves a lot of underlying issues in the blockchain ecosystem. From all the DeFi hacks to the problems in web3 social medias. This protocol explains the direction in which the blockchain industry should focus on.
how_its_made: While working on the POC we realized that we couldn't build the solution on the current chains. Since all the chains focus on tracking a user's value in their token instead of all the tokens combined, the foundation we were building on wasn't right. The chain of tomorrow will track the true value of a user through all the tokens they own.
